audit_items.proof_trace: All four public liquidation entry points (liquidate, liquidate_as_coin, liquidate_adl_borrow, liquidate_adl_deposit) call pre_liquidation_check, which invokes ensure_has_permission to assert the cap ID is in the whitelist and the relevant permission bit is set. PackageCallerCap can only be created via mint_cap (public(package)) through admin-gated mint_new_whitelist; new caps initialize with permission 0 and require an explicit admin call to update_permission (also AdminCap-gated) before any permission bit is set.
